method.graph: Only consecutive original OSM nodes. Original oneway direction respected. Crossovers included; yards/spurs excluded. Only the Seodaegu platform siding is allowed.
method.algorithm: Dijkstra from Busan source mainline node 1768990671 to Seodaegu source stop_position node 8259053344. No fabricated connectors.
method.sourceTrackDirection: Busan to Seodaegu, consistent with original oneway tags
method.endpointSelection: Source rail nodes; station POIs are not appended.

camellia.exactHistoricalTrackStatus: Not obtained from the public AIS pages examined; no timestamps per plotted path vertex are available.

extraction.method: Extract the existing dashed PDF vector. Evaluate its cubic Bezier segments at t=.25,.5,.75,1. Convert plot coordinates using labelled linear longitude/latitude chart axes. Reverse source order to Hakata→Busan. No invented offshore control points or terminal connector are added.
extraction.accuracy: Unknown positional accuracy of source overview map; output decimal places are extraction precision, not navigational accuracy. Several-kilometre differences from real sailings are possible.
extraction.portCutoffs: No artificial offshore cutoffs in display. Full sourceOverview is rendered; two separately labelled schematic terminal links are added.
extraction.displayUpdate: 2026-10-26: display the complete original source overview instead of cutting 17–23km short of the ports; separate two conceptual harbor links, never present them as surveyed tracks.
